summary: The art pipeline is done and the full first texture set is rendered: 58 textures, 119 PNGs including the east/north views and stuff masks, about 1.1 MB. A Python generator draws SVG from small shaded-shape primitives and renders it with resvg through the `resvg-py` wheel, because cairo and brew were not available on the Mac. One command (`tools/art/build.py`) writes everything into Common/Textures and rebuilds two contact sheets. In `tools/art/out`, `contact_sheet.png` shows all textures on a floor, and `contact_sheet_views.png` shows every south, east and north view. I looked at both and iterated until they were consistent. The look follows KONZEPT 14.1: warm outline, flat fills, one light line top-left and one shadow line bottom-right, no gold edge. Furniture renders at 64 px per cell and UI at 128. The Multi textures follow RimWorld's rotated-size rule (a 2x1 object gets a 64x128 east image). In-game rendering was not tested; `Source/build.sh 1.7 --tests` builds clean. The footprints for the kitchen stations, Roulette and Blackjack were not specified, so I guessed them; each is a one-tuple change plus a re-run. Epoch and Ideology style variants are not generated, only planned in the README.

integration_notes: Re-render everything with: uv run --with resvg-py --with pillow python3 tools/art/build.py (optional name filter as an argument). Mac tools like VectorCraft are not needed.
Graphic_Multi: west is the east image mirrored by the game. East/west textures are drawn with the size rotated, so non-square footprints have swapped east dimensions (done automatically).

Footprint guesses to match in the defs: FrontDesk 2x1, ShopCounter 2x1, PrepCounter 2x1, DoughBench 2x1, ColdStation 2x1, Grill 2x1, BankCounter 3x1, RouletteTable 3x2, PokerTable 3x2, BlackjackTable 2x2, CashierCage 2x2; all other buildings 1x1. If a def differs, edit cells=(w,h) in the @tex line of that texture and re-run.
Masked (stuffable) textures write <name>_<view>m.png: FrontDesk, ShopCounter, PrepCounter, DoughBench, BankCounter. Use a CutoutComplex shader only for these; others are fully coloured.
Items (Plate_*, Chips, Wallet, TravelBag) are 64x64; UI icons 128x128; CardHeader 1024x256.
Add new textures as @tex functions in tools/art/hhart/<module>.py (see README); the integrator can ask for more paths.
tools/art/.gitignore excludes __pycache__ and out/svg; the contact sheets in out/ are committed.
